name: Chalkie Chalkie
alt: The Chalkie Chalkie tutor dashboard, showing the next upcoming lesson above a filterable table of scheduled and completed sessions
description: Chalkie Chalkie is a collaboration tool for tutors and their students. It features lesson scheduling and real-time workspaces, enabling users to work through questions together.

name: Nurture Connect
alt: The Nurture Connect tutor home page, with a clock banner above shortcut cards for scheduling meetings and viewing recordings
description: Nurture Connect is a video conferencing and scheduling tool, built for Nurture Durham, a Durham based tutoring agency.

name: Rev up your walls
alt: The rev up your walls home page, showing a framed Porsche 919 Vision RS print propped against a wall
description: Rev up your walls is a portfolio site to display the process and artwork of Jason, the artist behind the brand. This site also contains a contact form to get in touch, or commission custom work.

name: Soft Blocked
alt: A Soft Blocked puzzle level, showing coloured blocks and their target positions laid out across a walled grid
description: Soft Blocked is a 2D puzzle game where you control the movement of a single square around a grid. You must manoeuvre blocks into their destination positions, while not soft-locking yourself in the process.
